subject.title: feat(web): unify the app on a paper & ember design language

question: Should the paper-and-ember palette become ClickClack's canonical visual identity across both light and dark web themes?
rationale: This is a subjective whole-product brand and palette choice that passing tests and implementation quality cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt paper and ember
options.body: Approve this as the canonical web identity and proceed after the changelog cleanup and WebSocket proof are supplied.

options.title: Narrow to objective repairs
options.body: Keep the undefined-token, scrollbar-visibility, and Vite WebSocket fixes while deferring the full palette redesign.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers establish a different canonical visual direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt paper and ember
recommendation.body: Approve this as the canonical web identity and proceed after the changelog cleanup and WebSocket proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The current global theme foundation traces to steipete's prior merged work, providing the strongest available product-history signal.
